input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Apple's operating margin for fiscal year 2025 exceeded 30%. The computed figures from the 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025 (ended September 27, 2025) show operating income of $133,050 million and revenue of $416,161 million, yielding an operating margin of 31.97% (133,050 / 416,161 = 0.3197). This exceeds the 30% threshold. The evidence review confirms that E7 and E8 (the underlying financial statement figures) and E11 (the derived operating margin) all ENTAIL the claim with proper period matching. Challenge H1 attempted to refute this by checking if the margin was ≤30%, but the numeric check returned FALSE, confirming the margin did exceed 30%. No evidence of material one-time items (H2) or accounting policy changes affecting operating margin comparability (H3) was found that would distort this calculation.
